items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Now, later on you must have studied with a Joseph Wagner in Boston. INTERVIEWEE: Well, he was the conductor of the school symphony.

ctx.x: No, no. I was ashamed to let people around Boston know I played oboe. The first thing they wanted to know was, 'What is an oboe?' They was just like I was. I never heard of an oboe until Dr. Holmes gave it to me.
Now, later on you must have studied with a Joseph Wagner in Boston.
Well, he was the conductor of the school symphony. He was the conductor.
